title: $\texttt{NFDiag}$: High-dimensional MCMC Convergence Diagnosis with Normalizing Flows
abstract: arXiv:2610.16574v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Accurately assessing the convergence of Monte Carlo Markov Chains is crucial for ensuring their validity in Bayesian inference problems. However, convergence assessment in high dimensions is known to be difficult, due to most convergence diagnostics becoming insensitive beyond a few dozen parameters. Conventional convergence statistics analyze marginal distributions which in high dimensions neglects increasing levels of information from the joint and conditional probability distributions. Thus we propose $\texttt{NFDiag}$, which taps into the information of the full multivariate joint posterior with a normalizing flow (NF). Our convergence diagnostic thereby also analyzes information from conditional distributions. In other words, by working in the full multivariate space, it is sensitive with respect to the geometry of the chain in high dimensions. translated_title: NFDiag：基于归一化流的高维MCMC收敛性诊断
translated_abstract: 准确评估马尔可夫链蒙特卡洛（MCMC）的收敛性对于确保其在贝叶斯推断问题中的有效性至关重要。然而，众所周知，高维情形下的收敛性评估十分困难，因为大多数收敛性诊断方法在参数超过几十个之后就变得不敏感。传统的收敛性统计量分析的是边际分布，在高维情况下这会逐渐忽略来自联合分布和条件概率分布的信息。因此，我们提出了NFDiag，它利用归一化流（NF）来挖掘完整多变量联合后验分布中的信息。由此，我们的收敛性诊断方法也能够分析来自条件分布的信息。换言之，通过在完整的多变量空间中进行工作，该诊断方法对高维空间中链的几何结构是敏感的。我们的诊断方法利用了归一化流假设独立同分布的轨迹这一特性（原文在此处截断）。
tldr: 该论文提出NFDiag，一种利用归一化流在完整多变量联合后验空间中分析链的几何结构与条件分布信息的高维MCMC收敛性诊断新方法，克服了传统基于边际分布的诊断在高维下不敏感的问题。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes NFDiag, a novel high-dimensional MCMC convergence diagnostic that leverages normalizing flows to analyze the full multivariate joint posterior, including conditional distributions and chain geometry, overcoming the insensitivity of conventional marginal-based diagnostics in high dimensions.
